profile.headline: Senior Vehicle CAN Bus Data Engineer

positions.title: Senior Embedded Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Lead engineer in developing OBDII, OBDonUDS, and J1939 related services for Netradyne's product
- Test FW and consult with development team to ensure the FW is defect free
- Experience with Vector CANalyzer, Vehicle Spy, CANoe, CAPL Scripting, CANEdge, SavvyCAN
- In-vehicle (OBDII and J1939) testing and debugging live

positions.title: CAN Bus Vehicle Data Engineer
positions.description:
- Lead engineer in developing OBDII and J1939 related services for Netradyne's product
- Test FW and consult with development team to ensure the FW is defect free
- Experience with Vector CANalyzer, Vehicle Spy, CANoe, CAPL Scripting, CANEdge, SavvyCAN
- In-vehicle (OBDII and J1939) testing and debugging live

positions.title: Energy Storage Engineer
positions.description:
- Design electrical enclosures by ensuring both mechanical and electrical requirements are met
- Make data driven decisions for logistically shipping batteries
- Design Fire hazard system by working with the Fire Marshall

positions.title: Battery Systems Design Release Engineer
positions.description:
- Complete ownership releasing battery structure components from initial design in CAD to production and to warranty for different programs
- Lead the development of working models to be used for validation and production
- Create and process Engineering Work Orders (EWO’s)
- Develop quality control procedures and inspection methods with suppliers based on DFMEA (Design Failure Modes)
- Lead activities cross-functionally across all different departments such as Purchasing Team, Design Team, Integration Team, GD&T Team, Validation Team, Quality Team, Manufacturing Team, Service Team, PPAP, APQP, etc. and external production and prototype suppliers to ensure components arrive in a timely manner

positions.title: Development Engineer - Electrification
positions.description:
- Experienced with creating and running test plans for electric vehicles
- Created and owned a common data analysis tool for the team to go through test data (DFSS Project - Leader)

positions.title: Energy Integration - Vehicle Performance Engineer
positions.description:
- Innovated new or existing technologies to achieve better efficiency to help customers and help the company financially
- Lead charging optimization project for Electric Vehicles

positions.title: Air Induction, Controls and Exhaust Warranty Performance Engineer
positions.description:
- Worked cross functionally with personnel from different areas such as design release engineers, dealerships, manufacturing plants, directors and suppliers to solve issues on and off field which saved the company $16,000 per day (DFSS Project – Leader)
- Looked over new vehicles launches and solve issues as they occur with integrity

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
- Gained experience with CLM Suite (DOORS Next Generation, Rational Quality Manager)
- Gained experience in Test Automation, Rational Performance Tester and Rational Function Tester

positions.title: Engineering Division Intern
positions.description:
• Worked with sprockets to increase the production rate
• Helped install gear motors with different horsepower
• Troubleshot problems with different kinds of sensors

positions.title: President
positions.description:
• Led a board of 8 board members and developed an appreciation for differences among individuals
• Helped organize 2 intramural tournaments for 140 players and planned 3 trips to competitions such
as away games, Regionals and Nationals
• Managed approximately $10,000 for trips and tournaments with Club Treasurer
• Interviewed with Onward State (campus newspaper) to promote the club

educations.fieldOfStudy: Aerospace, Aeronautical and Astronautical Engineering (IST Minor)
